heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Appropriate committees of Congress
tree.text: The term “appropriate committees of Congress” means—

children.text: the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate;
the Committee on Appropriations of the Senate;
the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs of the Senate;
the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives;
the Committee on Appropriations of the House of Representatives; and
the Committee on Financial Services of the House of Representatives.

tree.heading: ICT
tree.text: The term “ICT” means information and communication technology.

tree.heading: Western Balkans
tree.text: The term “Western Balkans” means the region comprised of the following countries:

tree.heading: Western Balkans country
tree.text: The term “Western Balkans country” means any country listed in subparagraphs (A) through (F) of paragraph (3).
